command: cooperbench run -n coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-minimal -s flash_10 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview --agent-config configs/variants/thinking_minimal.yaml --setting coop -c 3 --backend docker --git
agent_config:
# Variant config: thinking level "minimal" (the reference config uses high).
# Used for the model and thinking-level comparison. Pass via:
#   MODEL=<model> AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/thinking_minimal.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=minimal tools/run.sh ...
agent:
  cost_limit: 10.0

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: minimal
      includeThoughts: true
